ref.locator: rva-annual-report-2025-vol2, PDF p. 162 (printed p. 161), section 4.6 'Evolutie van de gemiddelde uitkering (UVW)', Tab. 4.6.I 'Gemiddelde maandelijkse uitkering van UVW volgens subgroep (in lopende prijzen)', row 'UVW-WZ', column 2025
ref.quote: UVW-WZ 1.214,84 1.303,45 1.366,74 1.429,46 1.461,17 +20,3% +2,2% | NB: de gemiddelde uitkering wordt berekend als de som van de bedragen gedeeld door het aantal budgettaire eenheden.
ref.note: Checked by a second agent: Value and quote verified; the text on the next page says 'De gemiddelde maandelijkse uitkering in 2025 bedroeg 1.461,17 EUR bij de werkzoekenden'. I corrected only the label: UVW-WZ means fully unemployed benefit recipients who are jobseekers, and the year belongs in the label because this is a 2025 average while amounts have since been indexed and the 2026 reform is changing the population. 'Gross' stays out of the label because the table does not say gross or net. It is per budgetary unit (full-time equivalent), not per head. The line also funds temporary unemployment, SWT, time credit and other schemes. Researcher's working: - 2025 average (no 2026 average published yet); amounts were indexed again in 2026. Per budgetary unit (full-time equivalent), not per head. The table does not say gross/net explicitly; RVA publishes benefit scales as gross amounts (withholding tax is deducted on payment). The budget line (4,836 M) also covers temporary unemployment, SWT, career breaks etc.; this unit is only full unemployment of jobseekers. Text PDF p. 163: 'De gemiddelde maandelijkse uitkering in 2025 bedroeg 1.461,17 EUR bij de werkzoekenden'.

ref.note: Legal ceiling for the first 3 months only; it falls to 2,446.60 (months 4-6) and 1,997.06 (months 7-12). Most beneficiaries receive less (2025 average 1,461.17). Under the 2026 reform benefits are limited in time. Minimum for a single person in months 1-3 is 1,645.54/month.
